newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF likely to offer T-bills next week--traders.
newsitem.headline: MOF likely to offer T-bills next week--traders.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer three-month Treasury Bills (T-bills) through a price-competitive auction towards the middle of next week, traders said on Friday.
The new T-bills will likely be issued to roll over 1.4 trillion yen worth of three-month T-bills due to mature on April 21, they said.
MOF is also likely to offer 10-year JGBs in the week starting on April 21, the traders said.
